nodes.label: Automotive Industry Card — Luxury Car Interior Dashboard
nodes.description: Industry card close-up of a premium car interior showing navy-blue leather upholstery, textured black plastic dashboard trim, and chrome control knobs and buttons. Represents the automotive industry use case for masterbatch in interior plastic components.

edges.note: Automotive interior plastic components rely on masterbatch for consistent color in dashboard trim and upholstery-adjacent plastics
